USCIS 不承诺固定审理时限，官方只提供各表格的平均处理时间查询入口。可用 I: USCIS commits to no fixed processing time; it only publishes an average-processing-time lookup per form. Premium processing via Form I-907 is available: for the I-765 OPT and STEM OPT categories it costs USD 1,780, the same for paper and online, and must be paid separately on top of the normal filing fee (Form G-1055 fee schedule, 2026-10-26 edition). In practice 2-4 months from filing to receiving the EAD is common, so the 90-day, 60-day and 30-day dates all need generous margins.
